_what: Load harness assertion modes (B1 §8.3, W4). `hard` must hold now and a failure is FAIL. `target:<owner>` is reported XPASS/XFAIL and never fails the pair; its owner flips it to hard in its own commit, citing a pair run whose XPASS turned into a hard PASS. After W4 lands this file is written only by the slot-A wave in flight (plan Phase 0, shared expectation files); slot B/C waves send the lead a flip request. Per-member scopes (a group's `scope` in the matrix) override a row for that member alone.
